{{Top|leg}}
'''Chattza Bay''' was a bay on the [[Sika Peninsula/Legends|Sika Peninsula]] of the [[Encheeko/Legends|Encheeko]] continent, located on the planet of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. Chattza Bay was completely surrounded by the large city of [[Iskaayuma/Legends|Iskaayuma]]. The bay was named after the controlling group of [[Iskaayuma/Legends|Iskaayuma]], the [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]]. Chatza Bay led into the [[Ioliu Sea]].<ref name="SotEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
